positive_spans.quote: A reference-guided narrative photograph of fictional characters, composing a freely chosen scene test around one readable encounter at the shutter. The supplied portrait informs the protagonist's visible appearance: her softly oval face, brown eyes, softly shaped lips, and jaw-length dark brown bob with airy separated bangs. Invent three adult working professionals at a co-working rooftop just after a small evening film screening. The protagonist sits in the middle of a low bench wearing an ivory blouse and charcoal trousers. The man seated to her left, in a navy cardigan over his work shirt, gently holds her left hand between their adjacent knees; her fingers remain willingly curled around his. He watches her with an absorbed, affectionate half-smile. On her right, another man in a camel jacket has approached her and is offering a single red rose, its bloom stopping beside her free right hand. His shy smile and gaze are directed at her face. She has turned toward the newcomer with a delighted, slightly flustered smile, her right fingertips just touching the rose's wrapping while her other hand remains linked to the seated man. Each man seeks her romantic attention independently, and she is visibly caught between two welcome invitations. The retained handhold and newly offered flower coexist clearly in the same moment. Empty folding chairs and the still glowing projection screen behind them make the screening's ending visible. Frame a naturalistic horizontal medium-wide photograph from slightly ahead of the bench at seated eye level, including all three faces and both distinct hand interactions with space between the arms. Warm rooftop string lights illuminate the faces against a cool city evening. Keep the woman's presence primary, with the two converging lines of attention making the emotional situation legible; realistic skin, cloth and small unposed smiles give the moment the intimacy of an observed social evening.
